meta.title: Evangelische Termine
meta.author: habakuk007
meta.description: Try the Evangelische Termine plugin: the Protestant events calendar from www.evangelische-termine.de, embedded with shortcodes and a widget. The demo pages load the events live.

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// One demo page per shortcode. vid 3216 is the organiser set in the plugin settings.
$pages = array(
	'et-veranstalter' => array( 'Veranstaltungen', '[et_veranstalter]' ),
	'et-teaser'       => array( 'Teaser', '[et_teaser itemsperpage="5"]' ),
	'et-panels'       => array( 'Panels', '[et_panels itemsperpage="6"]' ),
	'et-minical'      => array( 'Minikalender', '[et_minical]' ),
);
foreach ( $pages as $slug => $page ) {
	wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_type'    => 'page',
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_name'    => $slug,
			'post_title'   => $page[0],
			'post_content' => '<!-- wp:shortcode -->' . $page[1] . '<!-- /wp:shortcode -->',
		)
	);
}
flush_rewrite_rules();
